name: FLX4 (direct)
_readme: Direct profile: run flx4_wake.py BEFORE launching B2B Studio, then import this file. The controller stays in HOT CUE pad mode. See the README.
DDJ-FLX4 preset for B2B Studio. LEFT deck = d0 (Deck 1, mixer ch0), RIGHT deck = d1 (Deck 2, mixer ch1).
For other decks, start the bridge and answer its question, or run assign_decks.py on this file. Both write a new preset to import.
Hot cue delete: hold SHIFT+CUE, release SHIFT, tap the pad.
Each binding has a "doc" or "why" note explaining it; B2B Studio ignores it. Notes starting with CUSTOM mean the controller has no matching control, so the mapping is a judgement call.

d0@cdj-3000x:play.doc: PLAY/PAUSE button. 1:1 with the CDJ PLAY/PAUSE.

d0@cdj-3000x:cue.doc: CUE button. 1:1 with the CDJ CUE.

d0@cdj-3000x:beatsync.doc: SYNC button. 1:1 with the CDJ BEAT SYNC.

d0@cdj-3000x:master.doc: CUSTOM: the FLX4 has no MASTER button. SYNC long-press (note 0x5C) makes this deck the sync master, which is what the CDJ MASTER button does.

d0@cdj-3000x:temporange.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+SYNC cycles the tempo range, standing in for the CDJ TEMPO RANGE button.

d0@cdj-3000x:direction/sliprev.doc: CUSTOM: the FLX4 has no reverse lever. SHIFT+PLAY (Pioneer's reverse roll / censor) drives the CDJ slip-reverse lever position.

d0@cdj-3000x:trackback.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+CUE jumps to the start of the track, matching the CDJ TRACK SEARCH |<< button (the FLX4 has no track search buttons).

d0@cdj-3000x:calldelete.doc: CUSTOM: the CDJ CALL/DELETE modifier. Hold SHIFT+CUE (note 0x68), let go of SHIFT, then tap a hot cue pad to delete that hot cue. Needed because SHIFT+pad is a different MIDI channel and can't reach the hot cue itself. Not yet verified on hardware.

d0@cdj-3000x:loopin.doc: LOOP IN / 4 BEAT button. 1:1 with the CDJ LOOP IN.

d0@cdj-3000x:loopout.doc: LOOP OUT button. 1:1 with the CDJ LOOP OUT.

d0@cdj-3000x:reloop.doc: RELOOP/EXIT button. 1:1 with the CDJ RELOOP/EXIT.

d0@cdj-3000x:beatloop4.doc: CUSTOM: CUE/LOOP CALL < halves the active loop. On a CDJ this is the 4 BEAT LOOP (1/2X) button; the FLX4 has neither, so its CALL arrows take the halve/double job.

d0@cdj-3000x:beatloop8.doc: CUSTOM: CUE/LOOP CALL > doubles the active loop (CDJ 8 BEAT LOOP / 2X).

d0@cdj-3000x:cuecall_l.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+CUE/LOOP CALL < jumps to the previous memory cue (CDJ CUE/LOOP CALL <).

d0@cdj-3000x:cuecall_r.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+CUE/LOOP CALL > jumps to the next memory cue (CDJ CUE/LOOP CALL >).

d0@cdj-3000x:jogtop.doc: Jog platter top while VINYL mode is on (scratch). Relative, binary-offset (centre 64). The vinyl-off platter message (cc 0x23) is not bound.

d0@cdj-3000x:jog.doc: Jog side ring (pitch bend). Relative, binary-offset (centre 64).

d0@cdj-3000x:jog/touch.doc: Platter touch sensor. Tells B2B Studio the platter is held so the top wheel scratches instead of bends.

d0@cdj-3000x:tempo.doc: TEMPO fader, 14-bit (B2B Studio pairs the LSB on cc 0x20 by itself). Inverted so pushing the fader up speeds up, like the app's own learn does.

d0@cdj-3000x:rotary.doc: CUSTOM: BROWSE knob turn, relative two's complement. The FLX4 has one browse knob shared by both decks, so the same message is bound to both decks' rotary and both browsers scroll if both are open.

d0@cdj-3000x:browse.doc: CUSTOM: BROWSE knob push, opens the browser on both decks (shared control, see rotary).

d0@cdj-3000x:back.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+BROWSE push steps back out of a folder (CDJ BACK). Shared by both decks.

d0@cdj-3000x:rotary/push.doc: CUSTOM: the FLX4 LOAD 1 button. The CDJ has no LOAD button; it loads by pushing the rotary, so LOAD is bound to the rotary push.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue0.doc: Pad 1: hot cue A. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE A.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue1.doc: Pad 2: hot cue B. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE B.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue2.doc: Pad 3: hot cue C. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE C.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue3.doc: Pad 4: hot cue D. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE D.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue4.doc: Pad 5: hot cue E. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE E.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue5.doc: Pad 6: hot cue F. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE F.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue6.doc: Pad 7: hot cue G. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE G.

d0@cdj-3000x:hotcue7.doc: Pad 8: hot cue H. 1:1 with CDJ HOT CUE H.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/loop=1.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 1 sets a 1-beat loop (resizes it if one is already active). Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT LOOP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/loop=2.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 2 sets a 2-beat loop (resizes it if one is already active). Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT LOOP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/loop=4.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 3 sets a 4-beat loop (resizes it if one is already active). Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT LOOP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/loop=8.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 4 sets a 8-beat loop (resizes it if one is already active). Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT LOOP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/jump=-4.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 5 jumps 4 beats back. Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT JUMP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/jump=4.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 6 jumps 4 beats forward. Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT JUMP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/jump=-16.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 7 jumps 16 beats back. Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT JUMP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/jump=16.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+pad 8 jumps 16 beats forward. Stands in for the FLX4's BEAT JUMP pad mode, which can't be reached without the bridge.

d0@cdj-3000x:memory.doc: CUSTOM: HOT CUE mode button saves a memory cue (or the active loop). Without the bridge the pad modes can't be switched, but the buttons still send a note, so they're free for the CDJ MEMORY job.

d0@cdj-3000x:slip.doc: CUSTOM: PAD FX 1 mode button toggles SLIP (CDJ SLIP).

d0@cdj-3000x:beatjumpl.doc: CUSTOM: BEAT JUMP mode button jumps back by the app's current beat-jump size (CDJ BEAT JUMP <).

d0@cdj-3000x:beatjumpr.doc: CUSTOM: SAMPLER mode button jumps forward by the app's current beat-jump size (CDJ BEAT JUMP >).

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/key=-1.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+HOT CUE mode button (KEYBOARD) shifts the key down one semitone.

d0@cdj-3000x:screen/key=1.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+PAD FX 1 mode button (PAD FX 2) shifts the key up one semitone.

d0@cdj-3000x:quantize.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+BEAT JUMP mode button (BEAT LOOP) toggles QUANTIZE (CDJ QUANTIZE).

d0@cdj-3000x:keysync.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+SAMPLER mode button (KEY SHIFT) matches the key to the other deck, or resets it (CDJ KEY SYNC).

mx@djm-a9:ch0.trim.doc: TRIM knob (14-bit). 1:1 with the A9 TRIM.

mx@djm-a9:ch0.eqMid.doc: EQ MID knob (14-bit). The A9 has a 2-band mid (HI MID / LO MID); this drives the app's single mid control.

mx@djm-a9:ch0.color.doc: CUSTOM: the FLX4's per-channel FILTER knob drives the A9 COLOR knob (same job, different name).

mx@djm-a9:ch0.cue.doc: Headphone CUE button for this channel. 1:1 with the A9 CUE.

mx@djm-a9:ch1.trim.doc: TRIM knob (14-bit). 1:1 with the A9 TRIM.

mx@djm-a9:ch1.eqMid.doc: EQ MID knob (14-bit). The A9 has a 2-band mid (HI MID / LO MID); this drives the app's single mid control.

mx@djm-a9:ch1.color.doc: CUSTOM: the FLX4's per-channel FILTER knob drives the A9 COLOR knob (same job, different name).

mx@djm-a9:ch1.cue.doc: Headphone CUE button for this channel. 1:1 with the A9 CUE.

mx@djm-a9:hpa.mix.doc: CUSTOM: HEADPHONES MIXING knob drives the A9 phones A CUE/MIX. The A9 has a second headphone section that the FLX4 has no controls for.

mx@djm-a9:hpa.level.doc: CUSTOM: HEADPHONES LEVEL knob drives the A9 phones A level (see above).

mx@djm-a9:fx.depth.doc: BEAT FX LEVEL/DEPTH knob. 1:1 with the A9 LEVEL/DEPTH.

mx@djm-a9:fx.onoff.doc: BEAT FX ON/OFF. Only the channel-4 message is bound; with the CH slider on CH2 the FLX4 may send channel 5 instead, which is not bound (one control can only have one source).

mx@djm-a9:fx.beatl.doc: BEAT FX BEAT < (shorten the effect beat). 1:1 with the A9 BEAT <.

mx@djm-a9:fx.beatr.doc: BEAT FX BEAT > (lengthen the effect beat). 1:1 with the A9 BEAT >.

mx@djm-a9:fx.ch0.doc: BEAT FX CH SELECT slider at CH1 puts mixer channel 1 in the effect (exclusive). 1:1 with the A9 CH SELECT 1.

mx@djm-a9:fx.ch1.doc: BEAT FX CH SELECT slider at CH2 puts mixer channel 2 in the effect (exclusive). The slider's third position is not bound because its message is unknown.

mx@djm-a9:fx.tap.doc: CUSTOM: the FX SELECT button taps the effect tempo (A9 TAP). The A9 FX SELECT is a knob that takes an absolute position, so a button can't step through effects; see fx.select.

mx@djm-a9:fx.autotap.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+FX SELECT toggles AUTO/TAP (A9 AUTO/TAP).

mx@djm-a9:fx.select.doc: CUSTOM: SHIFT+BROWSE turn picks the effect, because the FLX4 has no FX select knob. Relative, sensitivity 5 so one click is about one of the 14 effects.
